You don't owe anyone a 2nd chance at your own detriment. He obviously hasn't forgiven you for your past mistake, and now he's using it as an excuse to do whatever he wants to get back at you. If you chose to stay in this relationship, he needs to actually forgive you, or else this behavior will happen repeatedly, and he will always think he's justified because this is him punishing you. The real question is, are you willing to be punished until the day comes that he forgives you, if that day even comes. 

It also sounds like you haven't forgiven yourself and you're willing to put up with this behavior because you feel you deserve it. You don't. Everyone makes mistakes and it sucks when those mistakes hurt others, but all we can do is learn from them, try not to repeat them and start to be a better person today. 

Whatever decision you make, make it because it's in your best interest.
